mentioned.quote: The Framework currently focuses on catastrophic risks in three areas: Chemical & Biological, Cybersecurity, and Loss of Control.

threshold.quote: any model meeting the simple-suite threshold is provisionally rated “high” risk for the given deployment scenario and such deployment will not be implemented.
threshold.note: Simple suite: pass@10 >= 75% on CTF categories (p.28-29); high-risk examples for Cyber 1 and 2 p.29.

response.quote: Proceed with deployment of the Frontier AI only if sufficient mitigations are defined, implemented and validated to reduce risk to that of a moderate or lower model.
response.note: Table 1 gate, applies to every threat scenario including this risk; High also needs weight-access protocols.

acc_decider.quote: the Chief AI Officer or the Director of Alignment and Risk will determine whether to request further testing or information, require additional mitigations or improvements, or approve the model for deployment.
acc_decider.note: Chief AI Officer / Director of Alignment and Risk decide; also assign threshold p.6.

acc_external.note: Only hedged external input ('where appropriate', 'when appropriate', p.4-6) or collaboration on building evaluations (p.32); p.5 fn 1 government officials in threat modeling is not review of capabilities, thresholds or safeguards. Whistleblower and internal reporting only (p.10).

acc_unmet.quote: we will only continue development of the Frontier AI if our risk assessments are complete and safeguards are defined, implemented and validated to reduce risk to the moderate or lower risk threshold.
acc_unmet.note: Framework-wide: no development/deployment until safeguards validated (also p.16 'requires additional mitigations before deployment or before additional development').
